data.body:
[P2] Document the simpler alternatives required by rule 2

The change adds another suspended-child handler and a separate chained-invoke test harness, but the PR description does not state which simpler options were considered or why they cannot work, as CONTRIBUTING rule 2.5 requires. The existing long-chained-invoke handler already waits and returns its payload, so the additional implementation needs that comparison. Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and explain the constraints and alternatives, including reuse or simplification of the existing fixtures and test setup.
